latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of executive-search-firm-coach.

- Provides step-by-step coaching for founders, CEOs, board chairs, and People/Talent leaders running structured executive searches for C-suite, VP-level, and board roles.
- Covers the search model decision (in-house vs retained vs contingent vs RPO) with clear tradeoffs in cost, quality, and speed.
- Details search firm tiers and market landscape, including major firms and specialist boutiques.
- Explains each phase: role specification, slate calibration, interview loop design, rigorous reference checks, offer construction, onboarding, off-ramp, and performance management.
- Triggers on common executive search scenarios and key phrases, ensuring relevant engagement only for buyers of search services.
